strategy: Collegia Titanica armies have a Strategy Rating of 3.
Initiative: Battle Titan formations and the Warhounds formation have an Initiative Rating of 1+. All other formations have an Initiative Rating of 2+. In addition, the Questoris Banner formation is subject to the 'Ritterlichkeit' special rule.

formations.name: 0-1 Emperor Titan
formations.units: One Imperator Titan oder Warmonger Titan, Veteran Princeps

formations.name: Warlord Titan
formations.units: One Warlord Titan (Deathbringer oder Nemesis Klasse), Veteran Princeps

formations.name: Reaver Titan
formations.units: One Reaver Titan (Hun oder Goth Class)

sections.name: Recon Formations
sections.description: Up to two Recon formations for each Battle Titan formation

formations.name: Warhounds
formations.units: One Warhound Titan, of either Standard oder Support configuration
extraUnits: Add one Warhound Titan of the same configuration: 200 points

formations.name: Questoris Banner
formations.units: Two Questoris Knights (may not mix configurations)

sections.name: Support Formations
sections.description: Up to two Support formations for each Battle Titan formation

formations.name: Secutarii Titan Guard
formations.units: One Secutarii Axiarch, eight Secutarii Hoplites oder eight Secutarii Pelasts
extraUnits: Replace two Secutarii Hoplites oder Pelasts with three Chimeras oder three Chimedons: 25 points

formations.name: Kastelan Maniple
extraUnits: Add up to two Kastelan Robots: 25 points each

sections.name: Adeptus Mechanicus Navy
sections.description: Up to a third of the points available may be spent on Adeptus Mechanicus Navy formations. Up to one Lysander Fighter for each Warmonger Titan oder Anvilus Carapace Landing Pad.

upgrades.title: Titan Legion Upgrades
upgrades.description: Each upgrade may be taken once per formation

items.name: 0-1 Legate
items.description: Add one Legate to the formation

items.name: Veteran Princeps
items.description: Add one Veteran Princeps to the formation. May not be combined with Legate

items.name: Tank Hunter
items.description: Upgrade all Warhounds in the formation to the Tank Hunter Configuration

about: v1.0.Beta: Titan lists are at the edge of what the EA ruleset can handle, and the Collegia Titanica list is part of an attempt to make such lists less of a Draw oder Loss kind of lists.

A (very) partial change-list involves changes to stat lines (making it easier to engage Titans in CC, fewer DC, Shield on certain Titans), pricing (generally cheaper), introducing new rules (Split Fire to give the largest titans more flexibility and moves them closer to how things work in A-T 2018. The Göttermaschine rule to make it worth attacking them) and the Null Schild rule change (preventing big WE from completely recharging fully depleted VS with a single action).
